main_body: A bonsai-style pine tree with a leaning brown trunk and three flat green foliage pads (upper canopy, right branch pad, left branch pad)
top_band: Foliage pads show lighter green tops (rows ~2-8, ~12-16, ~20-24) over darker green undersides; the trunk is a vertical form with no top surface. Organic canopy reads as volume with lit top and shaded underside.
evidence: The canopy pads are drawn as lit light-green upper surfaces with darker green undersides and a dark-green shaded lower edge, which reads as volumetric foliage seen from slightly above. The trunk is a plain organic form with a root flare at its base. It is an organic piece, with no flat architectural face. The pads have a light top mass over a darker front mass, so it is consistent with the 3/4 view for an organic object.

style.evidence: Outlines are dark green next to the foliage and dark brown next to the trunk, so they are tinted material tones rather than black. The canopy has about 4 greens with clumped pixel texture, and the trunk has 3-4 browns with bark grain and a dark shadow side. It is cleaner and somewhat sparser than the references, which carry 5-6 steps and individual leaf clumps with highlights. The foliage pads are large smooth masses with limited per-leaf highlight variation, and the trunk is fairly uniform in places. It is a decent piece but slightly thinner than the Beodeul references.
